projectDescription: A CLI utility that exports desktop launchers, icons, and binary wrappers from Toolbox containers to the host system, bringing Distrobox-style convenience to Toolbox/Toolbx.
keyFeatures: Export desktop launchers (.desktop files) from Toolbox containers to the host
Export binary wrapper scripts for CLI applications inside containers
Automatic icon extraction and placement from container app directories
Interactive removal of previously exported application artifacts
Shell PATH initialization for bash, zsh, fish, and POSIX profile
Zero-configuration — detects container name automatically from /run/.containerenv
Supports flatpak-spawn, toolbox run, and podman exec execution backends
Colored TUI output via lipgloss for clear feedback during operations
